card.name: Start of names and split words
card.fires_on: Responds to a word piece that begins or sits inside a proper name or brand name, like BEL in BELBUCA or BELSOMRA, Maiden in Maidenhead, or Albany in Albany-Fraser. It also fires on the middle of split ordinary words such as squadrons and quill.

modes.label: Brand and place names
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalized brand, place, or organization name that continues into more letters.
modes.example: Discontinue<< BEL>>BUCA if serotonin syndrome is suspected.

modes.label: Split common words
modes.description: A piece inside an ordinary word that is broken into several parts.
modes.example: deploy squad<<rons>> to Karachi, Australasia and South Africa

card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a name, or a piece of a long word, that is still going to be completed.
